net1.logged_out_again: you're logged out, log in again (ctrl-l)
net1.irc.reconnecting_unsent: twitch is reconnecting, so that wasn't sent
net1.irc.dropped_unsent: twitch dropped, so this may not have sent: {said}
net1.irc.login_rejected: twitch didn't accept your login, getting a new one (read-only for now)
net1.irc.not_linked: twitch isn't linked: link it at heatsync.org, or log in with twitch (ctrl-l)
net1.no_network: can't start the network, restart heatsync-chat
net1.no_decoder: can't start the picture decoder, restart heatsync-chat
net1.no_loader: can't start the picture loader, restart heatsync-chat
net1.yt.needs_permission: youtube needs permission to post as you — press ctrl-l → allow youtube posting
net1.yt.not_linked: link youtube first — press ctrl-l → link youtube
net1.yt.not_live: that youtube channel isn't live right now
net1.yt.chat_disabled: chat is turned off on this youtube stream
net1.yt.quota: youtube posting is paused for today, try again tomorrow
net1.yt.rejected: youtube refused the message (slow mode, members only, or you're banned here)
net1.yt.too_long: youtube messages are {max} characters at most
net1.auth.no_random: couldn't start the login (no randomness on this system)
net1.auth.linked_page: linked. you can close this tab
net1.auth.logged_in_page: logged in to heatsync chat. you can close this tab
net1.auth.wrong_window: this login link doesn't belong to this window. go back to heatsync chat and try again
net1.auth.no_port: couldn't start the login (no free local port)
net1.auth.logout_open: logged out here, but heatsync didn't hear it: your login there stays open until it runs out
net1.session.finish_linking: finish linking {name} in your browser (esc cancels)
net1.session.finish_login: finish logging in with {name} in your browser (esc cancels)
net1.session.chat_login_hint: {why} (if it keeps happening, log in again with ctrl-l)
net1.session.not_saved: couldn't save your login, you'll have to log in again next time
net1.session.chat_login_refused: twitch didn't accept your chat login
net1.session.chat_login_failed: can't get your twitch chat login
net1.session.kick_scope: re-link kick on heatsync.org to allow sending
net1.session.kick_expired: kick login expired, re-link on heatsync.org
